game_text_lines:
_Deploy Coruscant system, Imperial City, and A Sith’s
Plans. May also deploy If The Trace Was Correct._
*For* remainder of game, you may not deploy {episode1} Dark
Jedi. Whenever a character hit by Galen’s Lightsaber or
Vader’s Lightsaber leaves table, opponent loses 2 Force.
*While* this side up, may ▲ Galen’s Fighter. Galen’s
immunity to attrition is +2 for each Jedi present.
*Flip* this card if Galen or Vader at a battleground site
and opponent does not have a unique (•) character of
ability > 3 present at a battleground site.
game_text_back_lines:
*While* this side up, opponent’s Force drain bonuses
are canceled and your Force drains at battlegrounds
may not be canceled. During your control phase, may
retrieve 1 Force. During your control phase, may use 2
Force to ▲ any one card without ability. If targeting
a vehicle or starship with Lightsaber Parry, Tarkin’s
Orders, or There Is No Conflict, that destiny draw is +2.
*Flip* this card if opponent has a unique (•) character of
ability > 3 present at a battleground site.

notes: Objective, two normal bottom-half slips (756×528 / 756×523) on the purple Objective frame with the BLACK text box and white text (as the printed SE objective): front 17-Hunt_Down_And_Destroy_The_Jedi.png (heading/strip 'Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)'), back 17b-Their_Fire_Has_Gone_Out_Of_The_Universe.png (heading/strip 'Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)'), both number 17; front heading fully legible (no page bleed). Non-unique. Front: first two lines italic (deploy line), bold lead words For/While/Flip; inline silver round EPISODE I disc before 'Dark Jedi' → {episode1} (the stub renders it '[Dark Side] Dark Jedi' — the slip clearly prints the EPISODE I icon, not a Dark Force icon); ▲ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; '(•)' where the stub has '(*)'. Back: bold While/Flip; ▲ likewise; '(•)'. '> 3' as printed. Otherwise slip texts match the stub. No set sphere printed on these slips (diamond 17 at the bottom right). Base: Special Edition Objective 'Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe' (wiki page 'Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi' redirects to the VB4 (V) page). Destiny front 0 / back 7 (printed). Printed card: SE ring at the top-right, no Episode I icon → no ring_icons. Objectives carry no lore. Base scans 350 px; SE copyright line '© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.' faintly legible on the front scan. Modern: Virtual Block 4 VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif / VB4-D-theirfirehasgoneoutoftheuniverse-pre.gif (350).
